from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityInfo(BaseModel):
    """Equity information extracted from one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    equity_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label for equity as written in the document")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The equity value reported; negative if deficit/deficiency")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How amounts are expressed: 'thousands' or 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period/date of the financial statement")
    
class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_infos: list[CompanyEquityInfo]
